notes.title: Update 2021.12.0
notes.content:
[h1]What's new?[/h1][list]
[*][b]New Speedrun challenge - Speed 1[/b]
The challenge focuses on high-speed movement. Make sure to collect every speed buff!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41158409/1a7aff759309db6724e77197b95c3e4d173bd7d3.gif[/img]

[*][b]Added six new Achievements[/b]

[*][b]Smaller Bug Fixes[/b]
[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

The next updates will occur less frequently as we decided to release the demo of our single-player game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831540/USS_Tempest_Spaceship_Simulator/]USS Tempest: Spaceship Simulator[/url] at the next Steam Game Festival (earlier than planned). [b]Me Vs You[/b] will be our only Early Access game and the phase gets extended accordingly as we have major plans for next year.

Enjoy Christmas and New Year, stay awesome!

notes.title: Halloween Update 2021.10.1 - Two New Modes - Red Light, Green Light and Hunted
notes.content:
[h1]New Encounter Mode - Red Light, Green Light[/h1]
Our interpretation of Squid Game's "Red Light, Green Light" is fully available now. Reach the finish line and don't move when the clown's eyes are red. Avoid the obstacles on the field and don't forget to move in case the head turns and the light stays green!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41158409/412f44dde369657ae71a9a5fd1451123d744fec7.gif[/img]

[h1]New Shooting Range Mode - Hunted[/h1]
Tired of shooting at static targets? In this new mode you have to watch your back as you will become the hunted one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41158409/e5ec756d409771bd6c96ec7b220b136f2fd6696d.gif[/img]

Enjoy Halloween!

notes.title: Early Access Release Competition - Speedrun Pro World First
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

let's celebrate the Early Access Launch with a competition! Make sure to check out how to claim the Speedrun Pro world first on the [url=https://www.mevsyougame.com/]website[/url] before you start the attempts!

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
The next small content update is scheduled for the end of next week.  Please remember that your input is very important during the Early Access. We'll try to make hotfixes as fast as possible for everything you report!

Have fun and don't Rage Quit!
